newspaper.headline: Nusa Digital Opens a New SOC Desk
newspaper.lead: Nusa Digital has a new analyst at its SOC (Security Operations Center) desk. The job: check suspicious emails, links, and access requests before they hurt employees and clients.

tip.title: Tip: Read Domains from the Right
tip.text: The owner of a web address is the name just before its ending. In nusantarabank.akun-aman.test, the owner is akun-aman.test, not Nusantara Bank.

newspaper.classified: JOB OPENING: Careful SOC analyst wanted. Must enjoy reading from right to left. Ask for Rani, 3rd floor.
